notes.title: Developer Update: A new engine & status of Free Royale
notes.content:
Hello All, Beardy here! Just want to provide you all on the status of Free Royale


[h1][u][b]Where is Free Royale?[/b][/u][/h1]

This is a question we have been asked a few times and I wanted to clear up some things on what is going on.

Free Royale is a passion project from a tiny team who whenever they can put the time into development. As such other situations (work, family etc.) take priority. Whilst we cannot put a time set in stone we can share that we are still much working on the project. This brings us nicely to the next point.


[b][h1][i]The Royale is Unreal![/i][/h1][/b]

Thats right! When we started the development of Free Royale, we planned to use the Unity Engine to allow us to make maps and other assets more easily. Whilst we are more familiar with this engine we believe that the switch to Unreal Engine will allow us more freedom to make more detailed and engaging maps. This will result in most cases coding elements from scratch. We plan to keep you all posted on updates, including alpha tests and more.

This change will result in the minimum and recommended specs, which will be updated on our Steam Store when needed.


[b][h1][i]When will we hear more?[/i][/h1][/b]

We hope to make this from the post of this a monthly thing. We are providing updates where and when we can and can! We encourage the community to engage with us on our socials and Steam forums with ideas and feedback! You can do this here on Steam, on [url=https://x.com/freeroyalegame] X [/url] or our [url=https://discord.gg/HEaGjZ3kTu] Discord [/url]

notes.title: Check out our new Discord! (State of Arena)
notes.content:
Hello everyone! This will likely be the last post of 2021 (Unless something insane happens) so I thought it would be nice to provide a short update on the progress of Free Royale.

[h1]So What's the latest?[/h1]

I have news for all! Whilst development of Free Royale slowed down (due to world situation and small team size) we have not stopped and are planning some big things down the road for 2022!

We are not yet ready to annonuce the full details as of yet but you can keep updated for when we do thanks to our new dedicated Discord sever!

[h1]Sounds Cool. How do I join[/h1]

You can join the Discord directly via the Steam Store page and or you can use the following link to join! - https://discord.gg/DTJ4DecD4z

We cannot wait to share more of what is to come for 2022 and We will be sure to keep everyone posted as we get more news to share!

notes.title: Update on Game Progress.
notes.content:
Hello all!

It has been a while since we last posted an update about the game and although the development is progressing, due to the nature of our very small team there has been delays and interruptions that have affected our plans.

We consist of two developers that are mainly game hobbyists and as such is not our main job. We do work on content for the game when we have spare moments, usually after our work day. 

The reason for no public builds is purely because we feel that there is not enough content as of yet to share with you all and as such we want the first player experience to be an exciting and fun one. We have alot of plans for it and as a small team can be quite ambitious. 

We will keep you posted when updates come along as well as throw some teasers to what is being planned on our social channels.


You can find us on Twitter @freeroyalegame or @eczillla

Again we will aim to keep you updated when information can be shared.

See you all in the arena!

ECZilla.

PS: We have been noticing over on Twitch that our game category is being used for games that are not us. We would like people to know that this is not for any free game and will be used by us and our partners in the future.

notes.title: Version 0.233 Update!
notes.content:
Hello All! 

We are back with a small update that is laying the groundwork for the next major update! Whilst we have not got a confirmed date when this will be live we can say there is a couple of new things in this build! 

There may be small hotfixes before the major update as well.

[h1]Patch Notes:[/h1]

[h3]Added:[/h3]
[list]
[*]New weapon model held by player
[*]New scenary models such as trees.
[/list]

[h3]Changed:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Changed background of menu screen
[*]Adjusted volume of music to lower value
[*]Updated the game engine version
[/list]

[h3]Known Bugs:[/h3]
[list]
[*]In game volume slider is not functioning as intended. (Will be fixed in a hotfix patch)
[/list]


Thank you to all those currently testing and as for everyone else we will provide updates for a public test soon.

ECZilla

notes.title: ONLINE ENABLED
notes.content:
Hey all!

Surprise! We have now got online enabled. This can be used by creating / joining rooms.

Make sure to type a username before joining / creating to be able to play! Rooms are currently set to 10 per room and are on the now renamed Practice map!

Next Update we plan to refine this online such as adding names above player heads.


PATCH NOTES:

- Implemented Online Play
- Updated Lobby UI's
- Renamed 'Test Map' to 'Practice Map'

Got some more exciting things to share soon! So stay tuned!
